subject: Re: Pickup quote 20674 Hamburg to HAM on 2026-11-28
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for getting in touch! We can pick up your shipment in Hamburg and deliver it to the air export warehouse at HAM. Our all-in price is 126.28 EUR, and pickup takes 24 hours.

The quote is valid until 22 Nov 2026 00:16 UTC. No booking is needed; our offer reference is TRK-8572.

Best regards,
Nordlicht Haulage
